scientific_integrity: Analytical proof provided with reproducible finite tests; no claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact formula only for the explicit three-equal-slope branch pair and sequences with a limiting forcing frequency. It does not cover arbitrary circle endomorphisms or nonconvergent frequencies; broad multifractal framework priority remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Pathwise multifractal spectrum of rotation displacement for two degree-one circle maps
